# Vendored headers

Unmodified copies of the headers Wagyu needs, the versions PostGIS 3.6 bundles in
`deps/wagyu`:

- `include/mapbox/geometry/wagyu/`: [Wagyu](https://github.com/mapbox/wagyu) 0.5.0
  (9c87e553a51170e4ce85fd2ef3160bc3434eb751), ISC licence, `LICENSE.wagyu`.
- `include/mapbox/geometry/*.hpp`: [geometry.hpp](https://github.com/mapbox/geometry.hpp)
  1.0.0 (c83a2ab18a225254f128b6f5115aa39d04f2de21), only the headers Wagyu includes, ISC
  licence, `LICENSE.geometry`.
